scientific_question: Can the accepted bilateral c_proj chart represent mature integrated same-gauge weight-trajectory chords at useful function, and is its remaining failure representational capacity or causal transport cadence?

theory.diagnostic_correction: Muon deliberately maps a matrix gradient toward a high-rank near-orthogonal action, so isotropy of its one-step direction in fixed bases is not equivalent to high intrinsic dimension of the weight trajectory. The paper's PCA/t-SNE evidence concerns parameter paths, not optimizer actions.
theory.phase_oracle: For each accepted 5TPP phase and layer 0-7, fit the dense c_proj chord in the same gauge using hidden64+24 and output32 bilateral passes. Split the exact chord into 1, 8, or 32 equal substeps with full residual carry to distinguish chart-path capacity from one-large-step failure.
theory.functional_replay: Install only the fitted c_proj weights into the exact end-phase full-state snapshot and replay the registered 400-batch validation window. All attention, procedural c_fc state, normalization, residual stream, later layers, buffers, and head remain in the same checkpoint gauge.
theory.transport_control: A sequential 32-substep arm starts at step zero, consumes only each dense phase chord, carries its residual across phases, and is never reset to the dense c_proj endpoint. Its drift separates phase-local target-selected capacity from coarse causal transport.
theory.oracle_limit: Fresh target-selected connectivity and dense phase chords are unavailable to a deployable compact mapper. Passing authorizes only higher-cadence acquisition or a structure theory, never training.

causal_basis: At 0.5TPP, a high-cadence teacher-forced bilateral endpoint reached only +0.00473 to +0.00655 CE versus dense, proving useful early endpoint capacity but not causal trainability.

At mature 5TPP, the current chart leaves 72.58 percent of each sampled dense-Muon action, and neither a global orthogonal basis nor previous-phase sparse support improves over Gaussian/random controls.
The apparent conflict can be resolved only by scoring integrated mature weight chords at exact fixed validation loss; another training arm before this discriminator would be an unguided guess.

measurements: phase-local endpoint Frobenius recovery at 1, 8, and 32 straight-chord substeps
exact fixed-window validation CE for phase-local straight32 at every phase
terminal exact CE for phase-local straight1 and straight8 cadence controls
terminal exact CE for sequential straight32 residual-carry transport

interpretation.capacity_pass_transport_fail: authorize only a mature higher-cadence trajectory acquisition to measure the transported chart; do not implement from target-selected chords
interpretation.capacity_and_transport_pass: authorize only a concrete smooth chart-transport theory; implementation and training remain separately gated
interpretation.capacity_fail: reject this bilateral chart family at the tested mature phase cadence; do not blame optimizer transport alone

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
